title_en: Security checks 'S.C. Bannang Sata' base, bombers found in the area
summary_en: Security forces are on the ground to check out Bannang Sata police station after two bombs were thrown, one of them exploded and another hit. Five officers were injured. Buildings and motorcycles were damaged.
